title: Sponza at night with candles (Intel New Sponza, curtains, candles add-on)
description: The many-lights stress test: Intel's New Sponza with the curtains at night, lit only by a spread-out subset of the 10,000 floating candles of Intel's candles add-on (1,024 by default, the candles setting), each a point light with no range. Opt-in: only loaded when named.

candles.label: Candles
candles.description: How many of Intel's 10,000 candles to place: the first N of an order that spreads them through the scene. More is a heavier many-lights test.
